en.hubeali: H 14462 – Sahl, from Muhammad, from his father, from Abu Baseer who said: ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws the Statement of the Blessed and the Highazwj:
“[16:38] And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths: Allah will not raise up him who dies. Yea! it is a promise binding on Him, quite true, but most people do not know”,

he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Baseer! What do you (people) say about this Verse?’ I replied, ‘The ‘Mushrikeen’ (polytheists) are alleging and swearing upon oath to the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> does not Resurrect the dead’.

Imamasws said: ‘Woe be unto the ones who say this. Ask them, ‘Do the ‘Mushrikeen’ swear by Allahazwj or by Al-Laat, and Al-Uzza (names of worshipped idols)?’ I replied, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws, enlighten me’.

Imam<sup>asws</sup> replied to me: ‘O Abu Baseer! When our<sup>asws</sup> Rising One (Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>) makes the stand, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Send to him<sup>asws</sup> a group from our<sup>asws</sup> Shiites with the sheaths of their swords upon their shoulders. So that (news) will reach a group from our<sup>asws</sup> Shiites who did not die. So they will say, so and so and so and so have been resurrected from their graves and they are with Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>. So that (news) will reach a group from our<sup>asws</sup> enemies, so they will say, ‘O group of Shiites, what lies you speak. This is your government and you are speaking lies about it? No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, those have never lived nor will they ever be living up to the Day of Judgement’.
Heasws said: ‘So Allahazwj Quoted their words, so Heazwj Said: “[16:38] And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths: Allah will not raise up him who dies”.
en.sarwar: 14. Sahl, from Muhammad, from his father, from Abu Baseer who said: ‘I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s.) the Statement of the Blessed and the High (azwj):
“[16:38] And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths: Allah will not raise up him who dies. Yea! it is a promise binding on Him, quite true, but most people do not know”,

he (a.s.) said: ‘O Abu Baseer! What do you (people) say about this Verse?’ I replied, ‘The ‘Mushrikeen’ (polytheists) are alleging and swearing upon oath to the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj) that Allah (azwj) does not Resurrect the dead’.

Imam (a.s.) said: ‘Woe be unto the ones who say this. Ask them, ‘Do the ‘Mushrikeen’ swear by Allah (azwj) or by Al-Laat, and Al-Uzza (names of worshipped idols)?’ I replied, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.), enlighten me’.

Imam (a.s.) replied to me: ‘O Abu Baseer! When our (a.s.) Rising One (Al-Qaim (a.s.)) makes the stand, Allah (azwj) will Send to him (a.s.) a group from our (a.s.) Shiites with the sheaths of their swords upon their shoulders. So that (news) will reach a group from our (a.s.) Shiites who did not die. So they will say, so and so and so and so have been resurrected from their graves and they are with Al-Qaim (a.s.). So that (news) will reach a group from our (a.s.) enemies, so they will say, ‘O group of Shiites, what lies you speak. This is your government and you are speaking lies about it? No, by Allah (azwj), those have never lived nor will they ever be living up to the Day of Judgement’.
He (a.s.) said: ‘So Allah (azwj) Quoted their words, so He (azwj) Said: “[16:38] And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths: Allah will not raise up him who dies”.
